arxiv-2101-04873.title: Global smooth solutions to the 3D non-resistive MHD equations with low regularity axisymmetric data Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author Thanks: 1 School of Mathematics, Northwest University, Xi’an 710069, China Thanks: 2 School of Sciences, Xi’an University of Technology, Xi’an 710054, China Thanks: E-ma
arxiv-2101-04873.creator: Xiaolian Ai 1 and Zhouyu Li 2,*
arxiv-2101-04873.description: Abstract . The purpose of this paper is to study the incompressible non-resistive MHD equations in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} . We establish the global well-posedness of the system if the initial data is axially symmetric and the swirl component of the velocity and the magnetic vorticity vanish.

arxiv-2109-12975.title: Towards a Theory of Bullshit Visualization
arxiv-2109-12975.creator: Michael Correll Tableau Research
arxiv-2109-12975.description: Abstract In this unhinged rant, I lay out my suspicion that a lot of visualizations are bullshit: charts that do not have even the common decency to intentionally lie but are totally unconcerned about the state of the world or any practical utility.

arxiv-2112-13473.title: Dihedralization of Minimal Surfaces in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}
arxiv-2112-13473.creator: Ramazan Yol
arxiv-2112-13473.description: Abstract . It is a well known phenomenon that many classical minimal surfaces in Euclidean space also exist with “higher dihedral symmetry”. More precisely, these surfaces are solutions to free boundary problems in a wedge bounded by two vertical planes with varying angle. We study the limit of such surfaces when the angle converges to 0.

arxiv-2204-05627.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Learning based Control of Congested Freeway Traffic Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2204-05627.creator: Shurong Mo, Nailong Wu, Jie Qi, Anqi Pan, Zhiguang Feng, Huaicheng Yan, Yueying Wang, Mo S, Wu N, Qi J, Pan A, Feng Z, Yan H, Wang Y
arxiv-2204-05627.description: Abstract In this paper, a delay compensation feedback controller based on reinforcement learning is therefore proposed to adjust the time interval of the adaptive cruise control (ACC) vehicle agents in traffic congestion by introducing the proximal policy optimization (PPO) scheme. The high-speed traffic flow is characterized by two-by-two Aw Rasle Zhang (ARZ) nonlinear first-order partial differential equations (PDEs).

arxiv-2310-06277.title: Streaming Heteroscedastic Probabilistic PCA with Missing Data
arxiv-2310-06277.creator: Kyle Gilman kgilman@umich.edu, David Hong, Jeffrey A. Fessler Department of Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Laura Balzano Department of Electrical Engineering, Computer Science
arxiv-2310-06277.description: Abstract Streaming principal component analysis (PCA) is an integral tool in large-scale machine learning for rapidly estimating low-dimensional subspaces from very high-dimensional data arriving at a high rate. However, modern datasets increasingly combine data from a variety of sources, and thus may exhibit heterogeneous quality across samples.

arxiv-2405-12817.title: Curve of Growth Analysis of SZ Lyn
arxiv-2405-12817.creator: Janaka, Shashikiran, Peter, Santosh, Chandana
arxiv-2405-12817.description: Abstract We present one high-resolution and a time series of 561 low-resolution follow-up spectroscopic observations of SZ Lyn. It is a high-amplitude δ \delta Scuti-type pulsating star in a binary system. The photometric observations reveal the existence of radial and non-radial oscillation modes in SZ Lyn.

arxiv-2409-02647.title: Learning-Based Error Detection System for Advanced Vehicle Instrument Cluster Rendering
arxiv-2409-02647.creator: Cornelius Bürkle, Fabian Oboril, Kay-Ulrich Scholl
arxiv-2409-02647.description: Abstract The automotive industry is currently expanding digital display options with every new model that comes onto the market. This entails not just an expansion in dimensions, resolution, and customization choices, but also the capability to employ novel display effects like overlays while assembling the content of the display cluster.

arxiv-2505-13271.title: CSC-SQL: Corrective Self-Consistency in Text-to-SQL via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2505-13271.creator: Lei Sheng, Shuai-Shuai Xu
arxiv-2505-13271.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in translating natural language questions about relational databases into SQL queries. In particular, test-time scaling techniques such as Self-Consistency and Self-Correction can enhance SQL generation accuracy by increasing computational effort during inference.

arxiv-2507-08646.title: Additive sumset sizes with tetrahedral differences Thanks: Supported in part by PSC-CUNY Research Award Program grant 66197-00 54.
arxiv-2507-08646.creator: Melvyn B. Nathanson
arxiv-2507-08646.description: Abstract . Experimental calculations suggest that the h h -fold sumset sizes of 4-element sets of integers are concentrated at h h numbers that are differences of tetrahedral numbers. In this paper it is proved that these “popular” sumset sizes exist and explicit h h -adically defined sets are constructed for each of these numbers.

arxiv-2606-20376.title: CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking
arxiv-2606-20376.creator: Tristan Tomilin, Mourad Boustani, Mickey Beurskens, Thiago D. Simão

britannica-1911-hahnemann-samuel-christi.title: Hahnemann, Samuel Christian Friedrich (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-hahnemann-samuel-christi.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-hahnemann-samuel-christi.description: Article 'Hahnemann, Samuel Christian Friedrich' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German physician and founder of “homoeopathy,” was born at Meissen in Saxony on the 10th of April 1755. He was educated at the “elector’s school” of Meissen, and studied medicine at Leipzig and Vienna, taking the degree of M.D. After practising in various places, he settled in Dresden in 1784, and thence removed to Leipzig in 1789.

pmc-10485988.title: Asthma and COVID-19: a controversial relationship
pmc-10485988.creator: Carlos A. Dounce-Cuevas, Angélica Flores-Flores, Mariana S. Bazán, Victor Portales-Rivera, Araceli A. Morelos-Ulíbarri, Blanca Bazán-Perkins
pmc-10485988.description: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection induces a spectrum of clinical manifestations that depend on the immune response of the patient, i.e., from an asymptomatic form to an inflammatory response with multiorgan deterioration. In some cases, severe cases of SARS-CoV-2 are characterized by an excessive, persistent release of inflammatory mediators known as a cytokine storm.

pmc-11604315.title: Determinants of sodium intake knowledge and attitude: a cross-national analysis of socio-economic and health factors
pmc-11604315.creator: Santosh Kumar Rauniyar, Yuta Tanoue, Cyrus Ghaznavi, Hitomi Hayabuchi, Toshihide Nishimura, Yukari Takemi, Shuhei Nomura
pmc-11604315.description: Objective:The aim of this study is to conduct a comparative analysis across nations to: (1) identify the determinants influencing knowledge and attitudes related to sodium (Na) intake and (2) to analyse the association between knowledge and attitudes related to Na intake.Design:We utilised a secondary data from a cross-sectional study that was conducted across seven nations.

pmc-12768656.title: PP85 Access To Treatment For Hearing Loss In Chile: Do All People Have The Same Opportunities? A Scoping Review
pmc-12768656.creator: Erica Aranha Suzumura, Francesca Scandurra, Christina Schwarz, Michael Urban
pmc-12768656.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionChile has been conducting various efforts toward reforming the healthcare system, yet significant discrepancies persist in the equitable access to and utilization of healthcare resources. The aim of this scoping review was to map the existing literature on hearing health care and treatments for hearing loss (HL) in Chile to identify local determinants that may contribute to stratification of access to hearing health care.MethodsThe Joanna Briggs Institute guidance for scoping reviews was followed.

pmc-13260588.title: Systemic immune-inflammation index predicts post-thrombectomy outcomes and reveals a mediating role in the association between neurocardiac stress and prognosis: a multicenter study
pmc-13260588.creator: Long Yang, Han Zhao, Qingtao Xie, Qitong Chen, Yehong Liu, Hailiang Li, Jun Lu, Bo Du, Jiheng Hao, Jiyou Yu, Chao Sun, Yu Liu, Yujia Zhai, Haibing Liao, Yiming Yin, Hui Chen, Qiuchen Zhao, Yu Feng
pmc-13260588.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSystemic inflammation and neurocardiac stress are key determinants of poor outcomes after endovascular thrombectomy (EVT), yet their interplay remains poorly quantified. Existing models often rely on static factors and overlook the dynamic interaction between these two pathways.

pmc-13300871.title: Functional Status of Patients with Long-Term Mechanical Left Ventricular Assist Device Support in Relation to Physical Activity
pmc-13300871.creator: Julia Zuzanna Bura, Zuzanna Strząska-Kliś, Radosław Wilimski, Mariusz Kuśmierczyk, Daniel Karaszewski
pmc-13300871.description: Background/Objectives: Advanced heart failure is associated with reduced functional capacity and impaired quality of life. Left ventricular assist devices (LVADs) are increasingly used as a long-term treatment option in patients with end-stage heart failure. Despite improvements in hemodynamic function after LVAD implantation, many patients continue to experience limitations in daily functioning.

pmc-13459274.title: Group-based versus one-to-one occupational therapy to improve ADL ability in people with chronic conditions: a pilot and feasibility RCT of the Go:OT study
pmc-13459274.creator: Cecilie von Bülow, Signe B Bojesen, Vita Hagelskjær, Kristina T Nielsen, Eva E Wæhrens
pmc-13459274.description: BackgroundOccupational therapy interventions can improve the ability to perform activities of daily living (ADL) in individuals with chronic conditions. The group-based ADAPT program was developed as an alternative to usual one-to-one occupational therapy (UOT), aiming to enhance ADL ability through structured problem-solving processes and implementation of adaptational strategies. This pilot and feasibility study evaluated the feasibility of delivering ADAPT 3.

pmc-13608036.title: Proteome Remodelling in Candida auris During Early Host Adaptation In Vitro and In Vivo
pmc-13608036.creator: Rounik Mazumdar, Ana Bjelanovic
pmc-13608036.description: Candida auris is an emerging fungal pathogen that is posing a serious global health threat due to its high transmissibility and multidrug resistance profile. Despite recent molecular advances in scrutinizing this enigmatic microbe, much of our understanding regarding its pathomechanisms remains unelucidated.

pmc-13666182.title: Experimental Study on the Mechanical Performance of Large Plate Girders Under Eccentric Loading
pmc-13666182.creator: Yuxiang Zhang, Xiufeng Chen, Jinli Wei, Ju Chen
pmc-13666182.description: To investigate the mechanical performance of large plate girders used in boiler-supporting steel structures under eccentric loading, nine 1:5-scaled closed-section HK-type and open-section π-type specimens were designed and tested. The specimens had a span of 5960 mm, an overall length of 6220 mm, and a depth of 1760 mm.
